༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim thun mong

ma yin pa bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ 'dir bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi cha rkyen pra se na dbab pa/ gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs/ sman chen po'i bcud len sogs nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor zab khyad can du bzhugs pa las/ snying po bsdus pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yum bka'i thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs rim gyi khrid ni 'di yin te/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya maṇ+ḍal rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'khrid tshul dngos nyams len la gnyis/de kho na nyid thabs kyis bsgom pa dang*/ de kho na nyid dngos su bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la thun gyi thog ma'i bya ba/ dngos gzhi/ yan lag ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgom bzlas kyi 'jug tu rdzogs rim 'di rnams bsgom na des khyab/ sgom bzlas mi byed par rdzogs rim kho na la nyams len byed pa'i skabs yin na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra bar rgyas bsdus gang 'os re bya/ rang gi mdun du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po spyan gsum pa/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa zhig bsgoms te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ ces drag tu gsol ba gdab/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsams te bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor de/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i dmigs pa gang sgom kyang*/ thun gyi 'gor ji ltar 'os pa sgom dgos pas/ thun gyi thog ma'i bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rlung sbyang ba rang lhag par gnas pa/ rlung sems 'od gsal du 'jug pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtsa lam sbyong ba ste thog mar rlung rengs 'dul ba dang yan lag lnga sbyong ci nus bya/

de nas rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku can shin tu khong stong du gsal ba'i lte ba dang*/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i bar du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs zur bsnol zhing 'brel bas zur drug tu song ba/ dbus su zla ba la baṃ yig sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa dang bcas pa bsgom/ de nas rlung ro bsal/ lus gnas spyi dang mthun par bca'/ rlung phyi la 'gro ba'i tshe baṃ gyi 'od zer sna sgo nas phyir song*/ blos 'khyud tshad kyi nam mkha' khengs/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe 'od zer de rnams sna sgo nas zhugs te lte ba'i baṃ la thim/ 'di la dbugs 'gro 'ong rang babs kyi steng nas byed par bzhed pa ltar yang rung mod kyi/ 'gro 'ong gnyis ka dal bus byed pa dang sbyar nas bsgom na legs par 'ong ngo*/ /dmigs skor dang po'o/ /de nas gzhan 'dra ba las/ rlung thur sel la las mi 'chol/ gang ba can spyi dang 'dra bar bsgom/ lte 'og gi chos 'byung de g.yas skor g.yon skor gang rigs su 'khor zhing*/ 'os zer spro bsdu mi byed par dbus kyi baṃ yig kho na la sems gtod pa ni/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /spyir btang la dmigs skor dang po la myong ba thon pa'i rjes su gnyis pa 'di bsgom pa yin yang lag len du 'di gnyis spel gyin bsgom na bogs che zhing*/ myong ba sne rnyed pa myur ba'i dgos pa yod ces gsung ngo*/ /dmigs pa 'di gnyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim sgom bzlas dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ sngags 'khor gyi oṃ gsum ma'i yig 'bru rnams dang*/ dga' 'khyil baṃ yig la bsdus pa'i ngang nas bsgoms pas legs par 'ong ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni rtsa dbu ma'i sgo 'byed cing*/ rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs te/ 'di la dmigs rim gsum yod pa las thog mar rtsa a wa dhu tī'i dbus kyi cha la gnad du bsnun pa ni/ rlung gnad 'jam rlung kha sbyor la 'bad/

lte ba nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar du chos 'byung dmar po rkyang pa gcig bsgom lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan du grags pa spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam/ mar sna chos 'byung gi rtsa ba'i nang du zug /yar sna tshangs bug la reg pa cig bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i thad de/ chos 'byung gi kha mtshams dang mnyam pa'i thad du/ baṃ yig gam aṃ yig dmar po gang yid la gsal ba cig bsgom/ rlung ro bsal nas rlung bum can drag po bzung bas/ steng 'og gi rlung gnyis car baṃ la phog /sol me ngar ma bus pa ltar gyur pa las/ me lce phra mo zhig tsher gyis 'bar/ dang por sor gang tsam nas/ mthar sor bzhi tsam gyi bar du rim pas sbor/ gang ltar yang gtum mo'i me lhag ge 'bar ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ spros pa mang po spangs te 'di kho na bsgoms na 'phral du gsal stong ngang bde ba dang rlung dbu mar zhugs pa'i nyams myong skye 'di drod bskyed pa la yang ches bsngags pa ni 'di'i gnas skabs kyi yon tan phra mo ste/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /de nas yang rtsa dbu ma'i yas sna'i sgo dbye ba ni/ rang gi smin mtshams kyi nang du thig le dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs can sen mo zlum po tsam zur langs su yod pa/ dga' 'khyil lag bzhi pa'i ri mo can gcig bsgoms la/ 'jam rlung ran par bzung ba'am/ rlung 'gro 'ong dal bu'i ngang nas/ 'bud rngub byas pas smin mtshams kyi dga' 'khyil gyi thig le de/ g.yas skor ram g.yon skor re mos kyis drag tu 'khor bas lus sems bde bas gang ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ 'di la dbu ma'i yas sna smin mtshams su 'khyogs pa'i nang du thig le 'khor ba la sems gtod pa'i lus kyang yod mod kyi/ nges par rtsa'i dbyibs de lta bu bsgom dgos pa'ang min no/ /'di bde bskyed pa la bsngags te dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/

/yang rtsa dbu ma'i mas sna'i sgo dbye ba la bslab pa ni/ kha sbyor 'jam rlung dang bcas thur sel 'og gi lam gnyis ka dang por cung zad cung zad skul/ goms nas drag tu bskul/ rang lus kyi lte 'og sor bzhi nas gsang ba'i bar du chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gcig bsgom/ de'i kha mtshams thad kyi nang gi dbus su thig le dmar po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu la/ dga' 'khyil gyi ri mo yod pa gcig bsgom/ rlung kha sbyor gsang bar drag tu mnan pas chos 'byung mi 'khor zhing dga' 'khyil gyi thig le myur bar 'khor ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ 'dis stong nyams gtso bor skye ste/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rlung dbu mar 'ching ba ste/ 'dir bum pa can drag po sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi ngang nas 'di ltar bsgom ste/ lte ba nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar du chos 'byung dmar po lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma lte ba'i thad du aṃ dang bcas pa gong bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang yas snar haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba bsgom/ rlung bum can bzung bas/ gong bzhin lte ba'i aṃ las gtum mo'i me sor bzhi tsam 'bar/ de'i rtse nas dar dmar po'i rnal ma bskyang ba tsam gyi me lce shin tu phra ba rim gyis 'bar nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pa las haṃ las thig le'i rgyun phra mo ba thag lta bu'am/ dar dkar gyi rnal ma brkyang pa lta bu rim gyis babs te/ lte ba'i aṃ la thim pas 'bar 'jag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu byung ba la sems gtad do/ /'dis kyang rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa zhes grags kyang*/ don la ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gags/ dbu ma rgyas/ rlung sems bcings pas 'od gsal gyi rlung gi ngo bor gnas gyur/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan mtha' dag skyed pa yin na/ dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /gsum pa lam gyi yan lag 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang lus tha mal gyi rnam pa la sha khrag rus gsum spangs pa'i stong sang nge ba/

lus kyi dbus su dbu ma gong bzhin/ g.yas su ro ma dmar pa dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar ba gnyis gro sog tsam/ spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du rtsa gsum po gsum gshibs su yod pa/ ro rkyang gi mas sna gnyis dbu ma las ring bar yod pa de/ yar ldog ste dbu ma'i nang du chug /yas sna gnyis spyi bo nas tshur 'khyogs te sna bug g.yas g.yon du zug /lte ba'i baṃ yig gaṃ aṃ yig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas/ zhabs g.yas g.yon gnyis ro rkyang gi mas sna gnyis la reg ge gtad pa/ sku las 'od zer 'phros ro ma'i lam brgyud sna sgo g.yas nas thon/ 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad khyab/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ 'od zer phar spros pa rnams tshur ldog pa dang*/ lhan gcig tu sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i lam brgyud de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de 'dra lan gcig gam gsum sogs ji ltar 'os pa bya/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu ma'i lam nas yar gshegs pas/ ro rkyang gi mas sna gnyis/ rdo khab len gyis lcags skud drangs pa bzhin du yang drangs pa na/ ro rkyang gi yas sna gnyis po sna sgor zug yod pa'i mtshams nas bral te/ gru gu bsgril ba ltar hril gyis 'gril ba zhabs g.yas g.yon la thim/ phyi rol lus kyi rkang mthil nas brtsams te gsang ba'i bar rim pas yal/ bcom ldan 'das ma dbu ma'i lam nas snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo sogs su yar byon pa'i tshe/ dbu ma yang de'i rjes su thung ri li li song ba dang lhan cig /phyi dbyibs kyi lus kyang de'i rim pas yal/ tshangs bug nas rgyang gis thon pa dang*/ rang sems bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gsal ba de yang 'od gsal stong nyid du thim ste/ de ka'i ngang der dbyings rig dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu la mnyam par bzhag /de ka bskyar gyin yang yang bsgom/

'dir ni rang lus stong par sbyangs pa'i phyir/ slar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos par bzhed/ yang ro rkyang nas 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mi byed par lte ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma nyid 'byon bzhud byed pa dang*/ 'pho ba'i skabs sna sgo g.yon pa nas 'pho ba byed pa sogs dmigs pa mi 'dra tsam gyi spros pa 'ga' re yod kyang*/ dkyus su bshad pa nyid ma nor ba yin no/ /'di la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung yang zer/ gser chos dang snyan brgyud dang tshig brgyud du byed pa'i srol yod do/ /dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa de kho na nyid dngos su sgom par byed pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad bcas rlung rang babs su bzhag /sems ma bsgrims/ ma glod/ gang yang yid la mi byed par cham me bzhag cing*/ de ka'i rang ngo la cher re bltas pa na/ gang du'ang ngos bzung du med cing*/ blo'i yul las 'das pa'i rang rig rang gsal spros pa dang bral ba gcig 'char bas de la mnyam par bzhag /de ka la gnas na legs/ gal te rnam rtog 'gyu ste/ sngar byas sogs 'das pa dran na/ de'i ngo bo la brtags te/ 'das pa ni cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir na/ da lta bde sdug gi yul du yod yod ltar snang ba ni 'khrul ba ste/ skyes zin skye med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /ma 'ongs pa la brten pa'i re dogs sogs rnam rtog skye na/ de dag ni da lta ma byung ba'i phyir ci yang med de/ bde sdug gi yul ltar snang ba ni 'khrul ba'o zhes ma skyes pa skye med nam mkha' lta bur thag bcad/ da lta mngon du snang ba'i dgra gnyen la sogs pa'i rnam rtog shar ba na/ de thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin du 'khrul snang tsam yin no zhes skye ba skye med nam mkhar lta bur thag bcad do/ /dmigs bskor brgyad pa'o/ /yang zhal shes kho na'i man ngag gcig ni/ rlung sems 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i skabs/ sngar gyi de zla shas goms na rtsa bzang ngan dang*/

rtsol ba che chung gi rim pas cung zad myur bul tsam ma gtogs 'byongs yong zhing*/ de nas 'bud dus lto ba bcer phyir bzung*/ lus sprug rngubs te bshang sgor sdig / shugs bkyed 'dar thon par bya/ 'bar ba'i dus kha sbyor yang 'then cing*/ 'bab pa'i skabs kha sbyor mdun du brgyangs nas sprug pa dang 'phar rdeb gcig bya ste/ dmigs skor dgur yang bya'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid ni 'di tsam kho na yin la/ go don ni rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid yig bla ma rje btsun chen po grags rgyal gyi mdzad pa dang mi 'dra ba med pas der rtogs par bya'o/ /spyir rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag chen mo la yang*/ yab bka' yum bka'i rdzogs rim gnyis su dbye gsal byed pa cig yod cing*/ man ngag gces bsdus kyi nang na yang nā ro pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag bya ba/ nag po lam slong gi gtum mo'i nang tshan gcig dang 'dra rung ba zhig dang*/ brgyud pa gzhan dang gzhan las kyang*/ nā ro pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag tu 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod nyid kyi chos skor kho na la grags shing dgos nges pa'i rtsa a wa dhu tī'i man ngag ni 'di kho na te/ 'di shin tu 'khyer bde/ gdams ngag che/ gnad zab rtags 'phral du yong*/ /bka' gnyan pas dam por bya'o gsung ngo*/ /sngar yig rnying dum dum 'khrigs su yod pas go rim bsgrig tshul bla ma'i zhal la bltos pa yin na yang*/ deng 'dis bklags chog tu bkod pa ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas so/ /maṅga laṃ// zhus dag / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 98 -- PAGE 93 -- PAGE 92 -
